title: Gold PPO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
This policy applies to members enrolled in the Gold PPO plan for plan year 2026. Benefit coverage is subject
to member eligibility on the date of service and applicable exclusions.

title: Gold PPO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
Non-emergency outpatient MRI, CT and PET procedures require prior authorization before the service is
scheduled. Emergency imaging performed as part of an emergency department encounter does not require
prior authorization. Inpatient imaging ordered during an authorized inpatient stay does not require a separate
imaging authorization.

title: Gold PPO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
The first 10 physical therapy visits in a benefit year do not require prior authorization. Prior authorization is
required starting with the 11th visit. The authorization request must include the diagnosis, functional goals,
progress to date and proposed treatment frequency.

title: Gold PPO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
Gold PPO members may access participating specialists without a primary-care referral. Services that are
separately listed on the prior-authorization schedule remain subject to authorization requirements.

title: Gold PPO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
Chiropractic services are limited to 20 covered visits per benefit year when medically necessary. Visits
beyond the annual limit are not covered unless an approved exception applies.

title: Gold PPO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
Prior authorization confirms that medical-necessity review requirements have been met. It does not by itself
guarantee payment. Final claim payment remains subject to eligibility, benefit limits, coding accuracy and
other plan provisions.

title: Silver HMO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
This policy applies to members enrolled in the Silver HMO plan for plan year 2026. Covered services
generally require use of the HMO network except where emergency-care rules apply.

title: Silver HMO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
Non-emergency MRI, CT and PET procedures require prior authorization. Emergency imaging is exempt
from prior authorization when performed as part of an emergency department encounter.

title: Silver HMO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
The first 6 physical therapy visits in a benefit year do not require prior authorization. Prior authorization is
required beginning with the 7th visit. Continued therapy requests must include clinical progress and a
treatment plan.

title: Silver HMO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
A referral from the member's assigned primary-care provider is required before a routine specialist visit.
Emergency and urgent-care services are excluded from the referral requirement.

title: Silver HMO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text: Chiropractic services are limited to 12 covered visits per benefit year when medically necessary.

title: Silver HMO 2026 - Benefits & Authorization Policy
text:
Authorization or referral approval does not guarantee claim payment. Eligibility, network status, benefit limits
and coding requirements are evaluated at claim adjudication.

title: Advanced Imaging Utilization Management Policy - 2026
text:
This policy defines utilization-management requirements for advanced diagnostic imaging, including MRI, CT,
PET and selected advanced imaging studies.

title: Advanced Imaging Utilization Management Policy - 2026
text:
Prior authorization is required for non-emergency outpatient advanced diagnostic imaging when the
member's benefit plan lists the service on the authorization schedule. The request must be approved before
the scheduled service date.

title: Advanced Imaging Utilization Management Policy - 2026
text:
Requests should include the clinical indication, relevant history, prior conservative treatment where
applicable, prior imaging results when relevant and the ordering provider's requested study.

title: Advanced Imaging Utilization Management Policy - 2026
text:
Advanced imaging performed during an emergency department encounter is not subject to prior
authorization. Imaging performed during an authorized inpatient admission does not require a separate
outpatient imaging authorization.

title: Advanced Imaging Utilization Management Policy - 2026
text:
When contrast is clinically appropriate for an authorized imaging study, contrast administration is reviewed as
part of the imaging request and does not require a separate authorization unless the member plan explicitly
states otherwise.

title: Advanced Imaging Utilization Management Policy - 2026
text:
Authorization decisions are communicated to the requesting provider. A denial notice includes the applicable
reason and available review or appeal options.

title: Rehabilitation Therapy Management Policy - 2026
text:
This policy covers physical therapy, occupational therapy and speech therapy services. Plan-specific benefit
documents determine visit thresholds and exclusions.

title: Rehabilitation Therapy Management Policy - 2026
text:
For Gold PPO members, prior authorization is required beginning with physical therapy visit 11. For Silver
HMO members, prior authorization is required beginning with physical therapy visit 7.

title: Rehabilitation Therapy Management Policy - 2026
text:
Requests for visits beyond the no-authorization threshold should include the diagnosis, baseline functional
status, progress toward measurable goals, treatment frequency and expected duration.

title: Rehabilitation Therapy Management Policy - 2026
text:
Continued therapy must demonstrate measurable functional improvement or a documented maintenance
need allowed by the member's benefit plan. Services that are solely custodial are not covered.

title: Rehabilitation Therapy Management Policy - 2026
text:
Clinical documentation must support the services billed and should be available for utilization review or
post-payment audit.

title: Claims, Benefits & Appeals Operations Guide - 2026
text:
Benefit verification provides information about eligibility, covered services, authorization requirements and
benefit limits. Benefit verification is informational and is not a guarantee of payment.

title: Claims, Benefits & Appeals Operations Guide - 2026
text:
Participating providers should submit clean claims within 180 calendar days from the date of service unless a
provider agreement specifies a different filing limit.

title: Claims, Benefits & Appeals Operations Guide - 2026
text:
Claims are evaluated for member eligibility, covered benefits, authorization requirements, network status,
coding accuracy, duplicate billing and applicable member cost share.

title: Claims, Benefits & Appeals Operations Guide - 2026
text:
When a claim is denied, the remittance or denial notice identifies the reason code and available next steps.
Common causes include missing authorization, non-covered service, eligibility issues, duplicate claims and
filing-limit failures.

title: Claims, Benefits & Appeals Operations Guide - 2026
text:
A provider appeal should be submitted within 60 calendar days from the date of the denial notice unless a
contract or applicable regulation specifies a different timeframe. The appeal should include the claim
identifier, reason for dispute and supporting documentation.

title: Claims, Benefits & Appeals Operations Guide - 2026
text:
Operational decisions should retain the source policy, policy version, relevant section, decision timestamp
and reviewer or system identifier to support traceability.
